The shift you can make

Turn the work you have done into the opportunities you are ready for.

An MBA is not a magic switch—and it cannot promise a promotion or a particular salary. It can help you build a broader view of business, understand how decisions are made and strengthen the skills you bring to your next opportunity.

Move from only managing tasks to understanding strategy, people, finance, customers and performance. Keep your job while you work toward a stronger professional foundation.

Eligibility criteria

Is this MBA the right next step for you?

Check the key entry requirements before you begin your application. If you are unsure about your eligibility, submit your details and ask for guidance.

Submit Details →

Bachelor’s degree

Graduation from a recognised university in any discipline. English proficiency is required.

Minimum marks

At least 40% aggregate marks in graduation. Applicants below 40% may be considered through an admission test.

Made for working life

Suitable for graduates and working professionals looking to build broader business and management skills.

Keep your graduation documents ready when applying. Final admission is subject to Amity University Online’s eligibility and application requirements.

Questions you may have

Make your next decision with clarity.

The important details, without the unnecessary jargon.

Yes. The MBA is delivered online with live and recorded learning. Amity lists an expected learning effort of around 12–15 hours per week, so plan a regular study schedule around work and personal responsibilities.
The program duration is 2 years across 4 semesters and carries 102 credits.
You can build knowledge across core business areas, strengthen your understanding of business decisions and develop skills relevant to broader responsibilities. Your career outcomes depend on your experience, performance, skills and available opportunities.
No course can guarantee a promotion or salary increase. An MBA can help you develop business knowledge and prepare for opportunities, but outcomes depend on several factors including your experience, performance and the role or market.
Applicants need a bachelor's degree from a recognised university. Amity's published program information includes minimum marks and additional conditions; the admissions team can guide you through the criteria applicable to your qualification.
Choose based on your interests, current experience and the direction you want to explore. Options include Marketing and Sales Management, Finance and Accounting Management, Business Analytics, Digital Marketing Management, Human Resource Management, IT Management and General Management, among others.
Amity lists career resources such as AI resume building, mock interviews, 1:1 industry mentorship, LinkedIn analysis, skill development and placement assistance. These services support preparation but do not guarantee employment.
Published options include ₹2,07,000 one-time, ₹1,06,880 per year, ₹56,300 per semester or ₹8,906 per month for 24 months. Payment plans and eligibility may vary by option.
